phase: second TAP research layer — retrieval only
input: IntentRecord from the FROZEN TAP-E1 layer (imported through its public interface)
responsibility: select candidate evidence units only; no factual, policy, relationship, authorization, claim, or response judgment; never answer the user
honesty_notes: New synthetic enterprise corpus; no TAP-E1 prompt reused.
'Dense semantic retrieval' is a DETERMINISTIC idf-weighted concept-vector stand-in, NOT neural embeddings.
Results are mechanism/construction validation on synthetic text only — not real-world retrieval quality or production readiness.

baselines.F: full TAP-E2 pipeline (expansion + dedup + multi-signal ranking + gaps)

config_selection_rule: argmax on the DEV split of a documented weighted criterion (recall + ndcg + provenance + authority coverage + gap accuracy + (1-false_evidence) + (1-redundancy) - severe); simplest wins ties; the locked eval split is NEVER used for selection.
gate_application: applied to the DEV-selected config on the locked eval split; fixed before locked scoring.

verdict_rule.PASS_WITH_LIMITED_CLAIM: all gates pass (capped below PASS by the synthetic corpus + deterministic concept stand-in)
verdict_rule.FAIL: a severe gate fails, recall < 0.6, or 3+ gates fail
